about: Targets of the client-side evaluators tools/replay_eval/replay_eval.py and tools/evaluate/evaluate.py (specs/evaluation.md, high_level_spec.md §11): metric id -> threshold. Keys are exactly the metric ids of specs/evaluation.md; the metrics and their fixed definition parameters live there, the thresholds only here. A threshold is {op: '<=' | '>=' | '<', value} (a single number), {op: 'between', value: [low, high]} (a two-sided bound, both ends included), {parts: {name: {op, value}}} (a metric with several values, which passes when every part does), or {info: true} (information, no target). Extra keys of an entry are threshold parameters the evaluators read (tolerances, an absolute floor). A metric regresses when it is worse than the baseline run by more than max(tolerance_abs, tolerance_rel * |baseline|), using the entry's own tolerances or else the defaults. Edit the values here; no code change is needed. The gate parameters of the C6 metrics are measurement parameters, not targets (evaluation.md 'Gate parameters'), and are not held here.

locate.median_pos_error.description: median over located frames of position error / max(abs_m, scene_depth_share x scene depth): <= max(2 cm, 1 % of the scene depth)

locate.sigma_tightness_bound.description: median error / sigma of located frames, position and rotation each between 0.3 and 1.5

update.sigma_tightness_bound.description: median error / sigma of registered update frames, position and rotation each between 0.3 and 1.5

scale.error_by_direction.description: error: the worst relative scale error over four horizontal directions; within: that error over 3 x the stated scale_sigma_rel, and with a camera height and no priors |floor_z_m| over 0.02 m

objects.centre_error.description: round-4 value of the legacy map.stability.centre_delta_median_m

objects.label_agreement.description: round-4 value of the legacy map.stability.label_agreement

objects.id_stability.description: round-4 value of the legacy map.stability.id_agreement

update.later_wins.description: As before: the legacy map_update.absent_fraction (cup struck, 1.0), map_update.split_*.ids_persistent_fraction (0.95) and map_update.split_*.stability.centre_delta_median_m (0.15 m)
